name: Luna 9
intro: Privet! I am Luna 9, a lander shaped like a beach ball with petals.
Nobody has EVER landed softly on the Moon. Some scientists think the ground is deep, fluffy dust that will swallow me whole!
My plan: an airbag-like bounce, then I open my petals and take the first photos from the surface.
My batteries last about three days. Pick a spot where I can do my job!
briefing: We are over Oceanus Procellarum, a huge dark plain of old lava.
Four spots are in reach. Choose where I touch down!
fact: Luna 9 proved the Moon's surface is firm enough to land on: no bottomless dust!
